questions.question: Before Jonathan and his armor-bearer went to attack a Philistine outpost, Jonathan told his father Saul about the plan. True or false?
Before attacking a Philistine outpost with only his armor-bearer, what did Jonathan say about the LORD?

answers.text: Nothing can stop Him from saving by many or by few
He only saves when the army is big enough
He will fight for them once Saul arrives

questions.question: After Jonathan's attack, when King Saul and his troops marched to the battle, what did they find the Philistines doing?

answers.text: Waiting in lines ready to fight
